name: empty-state
title: EmptyState
description: What a view shows when it has nothing to show yet: an icon, a title, a sentence and the way forward; centered for a panel, inline for small places.

manifest.name: empty-state
manifest.title: EmptyState
manifest.description: What a view shows when it has nothing to show yet: an icon, a title, a sentence and the way forward; centered for a panel, inline for small places.
manifest.usage: Use EmptyState wherever a list, tree, grid or panel can be empty: first run ("No connections yet" with Add connection), a query with no rows, a filter with no matches. Say what is missing and what to do; offer one primary action. Compose EmptyState > EmptyStateIcon, EmptyStateTitle, EmptyStateDescription, EmptyStateActions; all optional. variant="inline" for a tree or a narrow list. For an error use Alert; for loading use Skeleton or Spinner.

props.name: variant
props.description: centered fills a panel; inline is a compact, start-aligned row.

props.name: render
props.description: Base UI render prop: render another element.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: icon
slots.description: A soft circle in color.bg.inset with the icon, aria-hidden; data-slot="empty-state-icon".

slots.name: actions
slots.description: A wrapping row of buttons; data-slot="empty-state-actions".

parts.name: EmptyStateIcon
parts.description: A decorative icon in a soft circle.

parts.name: EmptyStateTitle
parts.description: What is missing, an <h3> by default.

parts.name: EmptyStateDescription
parts.description: Why it is empty and what to do.

parts.name: EmptyStateActions
parts.description: The way forward: one primary Button, maybe a secondary one.
